adapter_hint: Wikidata population, capital and coordinates for every country: python scripts/fetch_wikidata.py --level admin2 --countries MAR
language_note: Mother tongue at the 2024 census: the shares of the population of Région de Tanger-Tétouan-Al Hoceima whose mother tongue is Arabic and Amazigh (Tachelhit, Tamazight or Tarifit). The two need not make 100%: the rest have another mother tongue.
population_note: The legal population of Région de Tanger-Tétouan-Al Hoceima in the 2024 census (RGPH, September 2024): 4,020,545 Moroccans and 9,677 foreign residents.
ethnicity_note: Nationality, from the legal population of Région de Tanger-Tétouan-Al Hoceima in the 2024 census: 4,020,545 Moroccans and 9,677 foreign residents.
sex_ratio_note: Men per 100 women in the municipal population of Région de Tanger-Tétouan-Al Hoceima at the 2024 census: 2,035,494 men and 1,973,161 women. The municipal population leaves out the people counted apart, in barracks, boarding schools, prisons and the like.
median_age_note: Interpolated within the five-year age group that holds the middle person, from the shares of Région de Tanger-Tétouan-Al Hoceima's municipal population in each five-year age group at the 2024 census, in the annex of HCP's provincial notes, given to 0.1%.
